measurement_scope: Each value is a caller Stopwatch around one public CLI process. It includes process startup, local retrieval/read and JSON serialization. It cannot isolate host-model inference; this smoke used no external generative model call. Backend tests ran concurrently, so times are not a like-for-like performance comparison.
